Item: Raw blue-500 buttons without semantic alias
Why_Bad: Tailwind default zero personality — screams unthemed template
Do_Instead: Use semantic token --color-primary mapped to your brand

Why_Bad: AI-slop signature circa 2023 — instantly signals generated UI
Do_Instead: Solid brand color or subtle same-hue gradient (e.g. blue-600→blue-500)

Why_Bad: Illegible at body sizes and distracting — looks like a CodePen demo
Do_Instead: Single color or subtle two-tone gradient on display headings only

Why_Bad: No color system — flat and lifeless with zero depth
Do_Instead: Layered surfaces with semantic depth tokens (surface-1/2/3)

Why_Bad: Confuses error signaling — users scan red as danger
Do_Instead: Use accent color or font-weight for emphasis

Why_Bad: Harsh on eyes and poor contrast — reads as terminal/hacker aesthetic
Do_Instead: Muted teal or emerald variant with 4.5:1 contrast ratio

Item: Pure black (#000000) text on pure white (#ffffff)
Why_Bad: Maximum contrast causes halation and eye strain on screens
Do_Instead: Use near-black (gray-900 / #111827) on off-white (gray-50 / #f9fafb)

Why_Bad: Most overused AI-generated font — signals zero design thought
Do_Instead: Research and choose font matching brand personality and use case

Why_Bad: Geometric rounded = friendly but generic — every AI chatbot uses it
Do_Instead: Choose based on product type and mood (e.g. Satoshi for modern SaaS)

Item: Comic Sans or novelty fonts in production
Why_Bad: Unprofessional and destroys credibility immediately
Do_Instead: Use well-paired professional typefaces from Google Fonts or licensed foundries

Item: More than 3 font families on one page
Why_Bad: Visual chaos and slow loading — each family adds ~100KB
Do_Instead: Maximum 2 families; use weight/style variation within them

Why_Bad: Breaks on mobile — hero text overflows viewport
Do_Instead: Use clamp() for fluid sizing: clamp(2rem 5vw 4rem)

Why_Bad: Destroys readability — harder to parse word shapes
Do_Instead: Reserve uppercase for labels/badges/overlines max 2-3 words

Why_Bad: Creates rivers of whitespace and hurts dyslexic readers
Do_Instead: Left-align body text; use max-w-prose for line length

Item: Bento grid with all equal-sized cards
Why_Bad: No hierarchy — everything competes for attention equally
Do_Instead: Vary card sizes; use featured card pattern (1 large + smaller)

Why_Bad: Looks toyish and unintentional — no visual system
Do_Instead: Pick 2-3 radius values intentionally (sm for inputs / lg for cards / full for avatars only)

Why_Bad: Performance killer and UX disaster — janky scroll on touch devices
Do_Instead: Disable parallax below 768px; use subtle translateY instead

Why_Bad: Accessibility violation and data waste — punishes mobile users
Do_Instead: Poster image with prominent play button; respect prefers-reduced-motion

Item: Centered everything with no alignment anchor
Why_Bad: Floaty ungrounded layout — text blocks feel disconnected
Do_Instead: Left-align body with centered hero only; use consistent grid alignment

Why_Bad: Lines too long destroy readability — optimal is 45-75 characters
Do_Instead: max-w-prose or max-w-2xl on text containers

Why_Bad: Renders differently per OS — not crisp and no consistent sizing
Do_Instead: SVG icons from Heroicons/Lucide/Phosphor with consistent stroke width

Why_Bad: No elevation logic — everything floats at the same level
Do_Instead: Semantic shadow scale: sm for resting / md for hover / lg for modals

Item: Missing cursor:pointer on buttons and links
Why_Bad: Broken affordance signaling — users cannot tell elements are clickable
Do_Instead: Always add cursor-pointer to interactive elements

Why_Bad: Feels broken and unresponsive — state changes are jarring
Do_Instead: 150-300ms ease-out transition on color/shadow/transform for hover

Why_Bad: Robotic unnatural motion — real objects do not move linearly
Do_Instead: ease-out for entry; ease-in-out for morph; spring for playful UI

Why_Bad: Jarring and feels buggy — users lose spatial context
Do_Instead: Always animate state changes with minimum 100ms transition

Item: Generic Get Started / Learn More CTAs
Why_Bad: No specificity and weak conversion — user cannot predict outcome
Do_Instead: Action-specific copy: Start Building / See Pricing / Try Free for 14 Days

Item: Stock photo hero with color overlay
Why_Bad: Generic template look — signals low-effort marketing site
Do_Instead: Custom illustration / product screenshot / editorial photo

Why_Bad: Overused skeleton pattern — distracting when applied to everything
Do_Instead: Subtle opacity pulse at 1.5s ease-in-out; reserve shimmer for content-shaped areas

Why_Bad: Too dramatic and unnatural — feels like a cartoon button
Do_Instead: Scale(0.97) with spring physics or 100ms ease-out

Why_Bad: Childish feel for serious products — appropriate only for playful brands
Do_Instead: Spring or ease-out for professional feel; save bounce for celebrations

Why_Bad: Accessibility violation — can trigger vestibular disorders
Do_Instead: Always check @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) and disable

Why_Bad: Only happy path designed — breaks in production on first edge case
Do_Instead: Design all 4 states: loading / empty / error / success

Item: Missing focus states on interactive elements
Why_Bad: Accessibility WCAG 2.1 violation — keyboard users cannot navigate
Do_Instead: 2px offset outline with brand color at 40% opacity: outline-2 outline-offset-2

Why_Bad: Majority of traffic is mobile — unusable layout kills engagement
Do_Instead: Mobile-first with breakpoints at 375px / 768px / 1024px / 1440px

Why_Bad: WCAG AA violation — text is unreadable for low-vision users
Do_Instead: Always verify with contrast checker; use gray-600+ on white backgrounds

Why_Bad: Screen reader and keyboard users trapped in nav on every page
Do_Instead: Add visually-hidden skip link that appears on focus as first focusable element

Why_Bad: Screen readers announce nothing — completely invisible interaction
Do_Instead: Add aria-label describing the action: aria-label="Close dialog"

Why_Bad: Robotic and unnatural motion with zero inertia
Do_Instead: Use custom cubic-bezier (--ease-spring-enter) or spring physics

Why_Bad: Robotic and mechanical motion
Do_Instead: Use ease-out for entry and ease-in for exits

Why_Bad: Overused generic AI cliché with zero intent
Do_Instead: Use specific verb: 'Start building free' or 'Claim workspace'

Why_Bad: Lazy copy that doesn't explain the destination
Do_Instead: Use specific: 'Read API specs' or 'Compare tiers'

Why_Bad: Leaves user stranded with no recovery path
Do_Instead: Explain what failed and provide immediate Retry or recovery action

Why_Bad: Generic confirmation that doesn't state consequence
Do_Instead: State exact action: 'Revoke API key for this team member?'

Item: Designing only the happy path without loading/empty
Why_Bad: App breaks or flashes white screen in real production
Do_Instead: Mandatory 5-state coverage: loading empty error partial ideal

Item: Raw unconstrained text without ellipsis or wrap
Why_Bad: Long names or emails break grid layout
Do_Instead: Enforce truncate or min-w-0 flex constraints with tooltip

Why_Bad: Chaotic visual noise during load
Do_Instead: Synchronized gentle opacity pulse (1.5s ease-in-out)

Item: Centered floating modal on mobile screens
Why_Bad: Virtual keyboard covers input fields and cuts off buttons
Do_Instead: Morph into swipeable bottom-sheet on viewports below 768px

Why_Bad: Causes missed taps and user frustration on mobile
Do_Instead: Add padding to ensure at least 44x44px hit area

Item: Missing inputmode and autocomplete attributes on mobile forms
Why_Bad: Forces user to manually switch keyboard modes
Do_Instead: Set inputmode='email' or 'decimal' and autocomplete

Why_Bad: Keyboard users tab out of modal into background DOM
Do_Instead: Enforce focus-trap with tab cycle and escape key dismiss

Item: Removing outline:none without visible focus replacement
Why_Bad: Destroys keyboard navigation visibility
Do_Instead: Use outline-2 outline-offset-2 with brand color

Item: Animating width height top or left properties
Why_Bad: Triggers CPU layout recalculation causing frame drops and high INP
Do_Instead: Animate only transform and opacity on GPU compositor thread

Item: Images without explicit aspect-ratio or dimensions
Why_Bad: Causes severe Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) when image loads
Do_Instead: Add aspect-ratio or explicit width and height

Item: Defaulting to single generic SaaS template without exploration
Why_Bad: Results in monotonous AI slop across all projects
Do_Instead: Explore 3 contrasting directions (Minimalist Structured Expressive)
